cues: Skimming and scanning are different skills.
Skimming looks for the gist: the eye runs down the left edge, reading the title, the first line of each paragraph, and the last line.
Scanning hunts one particular fact: you already know exactly what you want, and the eye zig-zags until it sees its shape.
